websites.name: Websites & Web Platforms
websites.short: High-performing websites, web apps, portals and e-commerce that load fast on any connection and convert visitors into customers.
websites.what: We design and build marketing websites, web applications, customer portals, dashboards and online stores. Every build is fast, accessible, search-friendly and easy for your team to update.
websites.who: Start-ups launching a product, growing businesses that have outgrown their site, and organisations that need secure, scalable web platforms.

mobile.name: Mobile Applications
mobile.short: iOS, Android and cross-platform apps that feel native, work offline and scale with your users.
mobile.what: We take mobile products from idea to app store: product discovery, UX design, cross-platform or native development, testing, release and ongoing improvement.

agentic-ai.name: Agentic AI
agentic-ai.short: AI agents and assistants that understand your business, take action in your tools and free your team for higher-value work.

agentic-ai.who: Teams drowning in repetitive work, customer-facing businesses that want instant, accurate support, and leaders exploring where AI creates real value.

edtech.name: Educational Technology
edtech.short: Learning platforms and tools that make education more engaging, accessible and measurable.

digital-transformation.name: Digital Transformation
digital-transformation.short: Strategy and delivery that modernise how your organisation works, from paper processes to connected digital systems.
digital-transformation.what: We help organisations map their processes, choose the right technology and roll it out, from cloud migration and system integration to data, automation and team training.
digital-transformation.who: Established businesses, public-sector bodies and non-profits ready to replace manual processes and legacy systems.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Jules TechRight (JTR) Ltd is an innovative technology company dedicated to developing smart, accessible, and impactful digital solutions. We specialise in websites and web platforms, mobile applications, agentic AI, educational technology and digital transformation.

Founded in Africa and headquartered in Lagos, we were built around a simple idea: great technology should be accessible to everyone, and it should solve real problems. Working in fast-moving, mobile-first markets taught us to build products that are lean, resilient and genuinely useful.

Today we work with clients across Africa, Europe, North America, the Middle East and beyond, delivering remotely with the craft, communication and reliability you'd expect from a leading international partner.

whatsapp-sales-agent.title: WhatsApp AI sales agent
whatsapp-sales-agent.summary: An AI agent that sells for small businesses on WhatsApp, starting with salons and food vendors in Nigeria. It chats in English and Nigerian Pidgin, answers questions, takes bookings and orders, sends Paystack payment links and reminders, and hands over to a person when needed. It works end to end in test mode; pilots with businesses come next.
whatsapp-sales-agent.imageAlt: The agent's test screen: a customer orders jollof rice and zobo on WhatsApp and receives a payment link.

jtr-website.title: Jules TechRight website
jtr-website.summary: The site you are on: a fast company website in English, French, Portuguese and Arabic (right to left), with light and dark themes, a built-in AI assistant and a contact form. Built with Next.js.

ufedo.title: Ufedo
ufedo.summary: A couples game made in Africa, live as a web app. Partners answer questions on their own phones, then reveal their answers together. It includes puzzles, Date Night and a journey across Nigeria. The games are free, with an optional UFEDO Plus subscription.
